scope: All samples in prospectively gated final stages; no outlier removal. Ratios of medians, unscaled MAD, ranges, and complete distributions. Quiet endpoints cannot guarantee no interruption inside a stage.

chord_ab.scope: Final sequential quiet-window public C1 A/B; parent receipt supplies whole-host admission; CPU 4. One warmup process per candidate followed by eight alternating pairs. Exact certificate/cell/evaluation equality required.

cli_profile.purpose:
Fresh baseline measurements. Every attempt is retained; no production edits.

Run from the repository root with .venv/bin/python. This is exploratory profiling,
not the final quiet-window A/B acceptance benchmark.
